title: Kessler Care Fleet Plan Cancellation Fee by Service Account Net Terms
content:
**Clause.** The fleet cancellation fee deducted when a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans is cancelled follows the net terms of the customer's service account. The tier is the one held on the account in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Service account tier | Fleet cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 10.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 15.00 |
| Any other account | The plan's cancellation fee |

**Points of judgement.**
- Only the account tier decides the fee. The account's balance and its late fees play no part in it.
- A customer whose account is a Service Guest Account or an Owner Rewards tier pays the plan's cancellation fee.
